svg.aria-label: From a pod lookup to an answer: 1. Query: A pod asks the kube-dns Service at 10.43.0.10. One of two CoreDNS replicas on control-plane nodes answers. 2. Plugins: Cluster names go to the kubernetes plugin. AAAA gets NODATA, because the cluster is IPv4 only. Other names are forwarded. 3. Cache: Answers are cached with prefetch and serve_stale, so a short upstream outage does not fail every lookup. 4. Forward: Unmatched names go to 169.254.116.108, the Talos hostDNS listener, not the node resolv.conf. 5. Observe: Port 9153 exports Prometheus metrics. The ready plugin gates the Pod, and lameduck drains it cleanly.
